title: Patrick Mahomes practiced in full on Wednesday: "I'm in a great spot"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patrick Mahomes practiced in full on Wednesday: "I'm in a great spot"
sources.description: While it looked at first on Sunday like Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes had suffered a significant elbow injury, it turns out he hasn't even missed any practice time.
